title: Niya: Muslim prayer tracker
description:
Stay connected to your faith with Niya Salah Tracker, the ultimate prayer companion for Muslims. Never miss a Salah (prayer) again with this intuitive app designed to help you track and manage your daily prayers conveniently, while also assisting you in managing your Ramadan fasts efficiently.

Key Features:

- Niya AI: Chat with AI for personalized Quranic guidance
- Quran: Read and listen with an audio player, voice options, and continuous playback
- Rak'a Tracker: Automatic rak'at counting via sound and vibration during salah
- Prayer Tracking: Swipe cards to mark prayers completed or missed, keeping your spiritual commitments on track
- Qada Prayer Management: Easily identify and make up missed prayers with the calendar feature
- Qibla Direction: Find the Qibla direction anywhere using the built-in compass
- Hijri Calendar: Reference Islamic lunar dates alongside daily prayers
- Consistency Record: Monitor your prayer streak and stay motivated
- Period Mode: Women can pause Niya during menstruation for flexibility and understanding
- Feedback & Support: Report bugs, share feedback, or ask questions for quick assistance

Download Niya Salah Tracker now and embark on a journey of spiritual growth and consistency in your daily prayers. Let Niya Salah Tracker be your guide towards a more fulfilling and connected prayer experience.
